messages.text: 'Like a mini World Cup' - Jacks sees positives in England's tri-series troubles

metadata.summary: Will Jacks intends to treat England's next two tri-series matches as a mini World Cup after defeats by Pakistan and Sri Lanka in their opening two matches boxed them into must-win territory.
metadata.content: Will Jacks: England in 'mini World Cup' scenario as they enter must-win territory in tri-series with Pakistan and Sri Lanka | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Will Jacks: England in 'mini World Cup' scenario as they enter must-win territory in tri-series with Pakistan and Sri Lanka England followed an opening loss to Pakistan with a shock defeat to Sri Lanka despite a record-breaking 202 from Harry Brook; watch England's next tri-series match, against Pakistan, live on Sky Sports Cricket from 7.30am, Sunday (8am first ball) Friday 23 October 2026 23:25, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Harry Brook rewrites the record books, becoming the fastest player to reach an ODI double century before finishing on 202, the highest individual score ever recorded by an England batter in the format. Will Jacks intends to treat England's next two tri-series matches as a mini World Cup after defeats by Pakistan and Sri Lanka in their opening two matches boxed them into must-win territory. England had looked set to bounce back from an 87-run hammering by Pakistan as Harry Brook's record-breaking 202 saw Sri Lanka set a massive 430 to win their match on Thursday, only for them to pull off a remarkable run chase on the penultimate ball. The two-wicket defeat means England arrive in Lahore knowing they must beat both Pakistan on Sunday and then Sri Lanka on Thursday to give themselves a chance of of reaching the final on Saturday, October 31.
